fields.label: Section (key)
fields.description: e.g. 194C, 194J-Professional, 194I-Building. The key the Supplier's TDS Section points at.

fields.label: Old section / new Act reference
fields.description: e.g. 194J / Sec. 393(1) Table 6(iii) — shown on the approval breakdown.

fields.label: Effective from
fields.description: Rules are versioned: computations use the latest rule already in force on the BILL date. Next year's change never touches booked entries.

fields.label: Rate % for Individual / HUF
fields.description: Leave 0 when the rate does not differ by vendor type (194C: 1% Ind/HUF, 2% others).

fields.label: Per-bill threshold
fields.description: TDS applies when a single bill exceeds this. 0 = no per-bill test.

fields.label: Aggregate FY threshold
fields.description: TDS applies once the supplier's cumulative GST-exclusive billing in the financial year crosses this. 0 = no aggregate test.

fields.label: Threshold treatment
fields.options:
Full amount once crossed
Only the excess over the threshold
fields.description: What the crossing bill is taxed on — configurable per section, per the spec.

fields.label: TDS Payable ledger (per section)
fields.description: One liability ledger per section — "TDS Payable – 194J", "TDS Payable – 194C" and so on (accounts, 2 Sept).
